{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined black knit with a straight cut, knee-length, hex #000000, wool blend.
Tailored grey trousers, ankle-length, hex #808080, stretch cotton twill.
Brown leather loafers, pointed toe, hex #654321, smooth calfskin.
Gold geometric stud earrings, medium size, hex #FFD700, polished metal.

This outfit works perfectly for a frosty morning commute to the office because the knee-length knit and stretch twill trousers offer essential warmth against the snow and cold while maintaining a professional silhouette. The dark neutral palette grounds your warm skin tones and deep hair color, creating a sophisticated look appropriate for neat business dress codes without feeling heavy in the daylight. The leather loafers provide traction on potentially salted roads, ensuring comfort during your twenty-minute walk, while the subtle gold accessories add a touch of personality that elevates the ensemble beyond basic workwear."}
